name: demo-playwright-javascript-for-google-maps
summary: A beginner-friendly Playwright + JavaScript demo that describes driving a real browser against the real, live Google Maps website, with canvas-aware, deliberately modest assertions. Must never be run against live google.com in CI or automated tooling.
description: This demo describes using Playwright and JavaScript to drive a real Chromium browser to https://www.google.com/maps and run three real assertion-based checks: the page title, the URL after searching "Cardiff Castle", and the URL's embedded zoom-level number after clicking zoom in. Assertions are kept modest and honest because most of Google Maps renders to canvas/WebGL rather than to regular DOM elements. Written from documented knowledge of Google's well-known, stable accessible markup rather than live verification, because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of its services.
